Info

﻿
The Bruce Springsteen Collection 6-album box set
Label (Cat #): CBS (465920 1)
Format: 6xLP
Country: Australia
Release date (Original year): 1988 (1988)
Record 1: "Greetings From Asbury Park N.J."
Aussie pressing
Cat# CBS SBP 234758
Picture sleeve, transparent plastic inner bag, orange/yellow labels

Record 2: "The Wild, The Innocent, & The E Street Shuffle"
Aussie pressing
Cat# CBS SBP 234454
Picture sleeve, transparent plastic inner bag, orange/yellow labels

Record 3: "Born To Run"
Aussie pressing
Cat# CBS SBP 234729
Picture sleeve, transparent plastic inner bag, orange/yellow labels

Record 4: "Darkness On The Edge OF Town"
Aussie pressing
Cat# CBS SBP 237136
Picture sleeve, lyrics inner bag, lyrics insert, orange/yellow labels

Record 5: "Born In The USA"
Aussie pressing
Cat# CBS SBP 238008
Picture sleeve, picture inner bag, orange/yellow labels

Record 6: "Tunnel Of Love"
Aussie pressing
Cat# CBS 460270 1
Picture sleeve, picture inner bag, orange/yellow labels

Also includes a 4-page picture insert.

Notes from Lost In The Flood:
Extremely rare Australia-only release; also issued on the CD and cassette formats (465920 2 and 465920 4, respectively) which are equally difficult to find. Box features a transparent hard plastic lid with paper inlay depicting a unique colour illustration of the American flag and title graphics, and includes Australian pressings of the first four albums (with "Born To Run" coming in a single, non-gatefold sleeve) plus "Born In The U.S.A." and "Tunnel Of Love"; accompanied by a 4-page insert.
